How it works

Three steps, then it is done.

01

Add your business details

Name, services, rates, payment terms, VAT number. Once — it is used on every document after that.

02

Ask in plain English

“Quote for fitting a shop counter, three days labour plus materials.” No forms beyond the obvious ones.

03

Print or send

The draft appears ready to send, with a branded PDF you can attach to an email the same minute.

Stop doing admin at 9pm.

Questions

Is there a contract?

No. Plans are monthly and you can cancel whenever you like — you keep access until the end of the period you have paid for.

What counts as a document?

Any finished item AdminMate creates for you: an email, letter, quote, invoice, reminder, proposal, meeting summary, report or action plan. The allowance resets on the first of each month.

Do I need to install anything?

No. It runs in your browser on a laptop, tablet or phone, and the app also works offline once loaded.

Where is my data kept?

In the browser you are using, on your own device. Nothing is uploaded to a server, and you can export a full JSON backup at any time from the Business profile screen.

Is VAT included?

Prices are shown excluding VAT. Your own VAT number and rate are used on the documents you issue, not on your AdminMate subscription.
